action: 129 current Q/As retained and post counts match the prepared release. No Google FAQ rich-result promise: the feature was retired.

control: Semantic list elements in article body
action: Reusable HTML lists are supported, but all 23 exported posts still have literal bullet/number lists in paragraphs. Render real ul/ol/li in prose while preserving appearance; related/source lists are not a substitute.
The table snippet works, but the OWASP guide retains a pipe-delimited Markdown mapping table as paragraph text. Convert that specific table to table/th/td.

control: Accessible TOC component for longer articles
action: Current template has the TOC hook and prior matching-build browser evidence. Peers were not browser-tested; no TOC was detected in sampled raw HTML.

control: Internal links occur inside article body
action: Related navigation works; only two current posts have prose-level internal links after excluding related/source/FAQ sections. Add contextual links where useful, or a substantial topic hub.

control: Outbound links occur inside article body
action: Four current posts contain outbound links, including the corrected references. On peers these can be ads/promotions, not citations. Review primary evidence for claims; never target an arbitrary link count.

control: Every sampled image has an alt attribute
action: Current article images have alt; ten live Popular-sidebar thumbnails on home still omit it. Inspect the saved widget; use empty alt for redundant thumbnails.

control: Images declare intrinsic width and height
action: Current generated images have dimensions; the saved home thumbnails need a reservation review. CSS aspect-ratio can also reserve space; missing attributes alone do not prove CLS.

control: Lazy-loading attributes are present for images
action: Already supported. Raw attributes do not establish correct above/below-fold selection; preserve early LCP discovery.
No current srcset was found. Add owned, genuinely fetchable size variants/sizes and optimize the heavy covers; do not invent unhosted URLs.
Current image URL properties are supported schema. ImageObject/dimensions/alt metadata can improve portability if accurate; it is not required simply because peers emit it.
Font preconnects already exist. Resource hints are not a substitute for measured LCP/CLS/INP.
Current label navigation exists; do not index every search/label archive automatically. Consider a genuinely useful curated native Page instead.

control: Feed discovery links and pagination exist
action: Current feeds and listing navigation are present. This research counts peer links, not successful feed subscription or every pagination page.

control: llms.txt treated as optional rather than a ranking requirement
action: No genuine llms.txt detected among 20 peers. Google does not require it; themes cannot publish arbitrary root text files. No mandatory fix.

control: Saved native post/Page description and FAQ round-trip
action: Existing hosted route fallbacks work, but a controlled newly saved native post/Page is still needed to prove editor-field priority/retention.

control: Search Console/Bing actual indexing and AI reports
action: Owner verifies selected canonicals, sitemap processing, search queries and AI reports. HTML/schema/Tranco ranks cannot establish citations.
Prior local diagnostics identify heavy assets/shifts/contrast. No fresh peer browser/CWV, field INP, screen-reader or physical-device certification was performed here.

control: Claims, author identity and policy text are accurate
action: All 23 live post bodies match the corrected local bodies and no placeholders remain. Two titles conflict with corrected content; Privacy identity and comprehensive expert checks remain.

control: Search access, training preference and generative-search controls are deliberate
action: Public robots permits discovery. Review owner Search Console generative-AI choice and separate training preference; user-agent text alone is not verified crawler access.

control: No ranking myths, hidden AI prompts or forced schema formats
action: Keep microdata, natural topic phrases and useful answers. Do not copy legacy keywords, schema stuffing, fake ratings or fabricated update dates from peers. No style changes are required by this research.
